notes: Curated royalty-free SFX catalogue for HNC League social Reels. The real-crowd core (stadium beds, anticipation rises, goal roars, disappointment groan) is bundled Freesound CC0 audio — see SOURCES.md for provenance; production renders these samples and falls back to the deterministic procedural HNC synth only when a file is missing/corrupt (see src/audio/library.ts + src/audio/mix.ts). Remaining Mixkit/Pixabay entries are catalogue-only placeholders (bundled:false): BEFORE downloading any such file, open sourcePage, verify that individual asset's commercial/social-use permission, then drop the file into packages/social-video/assets/audio/<file> and flip bundled:true. Mixkit SFX are under the Mixkit Sound Effects Free License (free for commercial use, no attribution required — verify per asset at https://mixkit.co/license/). Pixabay entries are under the Pixabay Content License (free for commercial use, no attribution required — verify per asset on its Pixabay page). CC BY-NC assets are rejected by validateAudioManifest and must never be added for promotional content.
